extracted.name: Healthy sugarless Dry fruit chocolate cake
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup jamoon powder or all purpose flour
instruction_lines: Soak the dry fruits with milk for 30-45 minutes
Blend the soaked dry fruits with milk + banana + vanilla essence + oil
Transfer the above mixture to a bowl. Now add dry ingredients (flour + cock powder) using sieve. Mix all ingredients nicely. Don’t over mix
Now take a ramekin. Brush the oil. Transfer the mixture. Bake it at 360F for 35-40 minutes
